title: Fix AI enrichment Unavailable message when ChatGPT IS connected; add Enrich Now button
goal: In findings drawer: when finding enrichment_state=unavailable but AI IS globally connected and finding_enrichment_enabled=true, show 'This finding has not been enriched yet' with an Enrich Now button that calls POST /api/v1/findings/{id}/ai-enrich. Add this endpoint to findings router, delegating to the existing ai_finding_enrichment service. The existing 'Connect or enable an AI provider' message must only show when AI is truly disconnected or finding_enrichment_enabled=false.
scope: Walkthrough 2026-04-30: Finding drawer shows 'Enrichment unavailable - Connect or enable an AI provider' even though ChatGPT OAuth IS connected (google-oauth2, gpt-5.4, finding_enrichment_enabled=true). Root cause: enrichment_state=unavailable was set at finding creation when AI was disabled at that time. Now AI is connected but no on-demand trigger exists. The message incorrectly implies AI is disconnected and confuses the operator.
